references.text: Moses exhorts the people to keep the laws and statutes that God has given them
God commands Moses to teach the people the commandments, laws, and statutes
The command to impress God's words upon children and speak of them
Command to teach children God's words and speak of them
Prayer that the Lord will show His ways and teach His paths
The Lord promises to instruct and show the way one should go
Prayer to be taught the Lord's statutes and to keep them
Nations shall come to learn the Lord's ways and walk in His paths
The priests shall teach the people the difference between holy and common, clean and unclean
Jesus commands the disciples to teach all nations to observe everything He has commanded
Paul testifies that he has proclaimed the whole counsel and will of God
This is a direct parallel where the same mission (to teach the law in order to follow it in the land) is described with nearly identical wording.
The same theological principle regarding Moses' role as teacher of the law to ensure the people live righteously in the land.
Repetition of the same mandate to teach the law so that the people may live by it in the promised land.
